review_comment: I know I didn't do it in `BucketedSort`, but could you please leave a javadoc describing the layout of this one? I believe it's something like "Each bucket reserves `bucketSize` slots. Each set of slots starts in "gather" mode and transitions to "heap" mode when it has `bucketSize` values added.
